versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Work Productivity Skill Vetter Workflow Helper.

- Provides structured workflows and checklists for Skill Vetter-style productivity needs, based on strong validated user demand.
- Supports users in bug fixing, hardening setup/safety, boosting reliability, and developing adjacent workflows or artifacts.
- Optimized for local hardware: uses scripts, templates, and CPU-friendly processes.
- Includes built-in validation, output verification, and prompts for any missing critical information.
- Activated by productivity, vetter, security, and implementation-related keywords and scenarios.
